text: Problem 7: Build a decision tree to find the minimum of 3 numbers. Repeat for 4 numbers. Each node in the decision tree represents a comparison of exactly 2 numbers. For the general version of n numbers, what is the shortest possible path in the tree? Use the result to explain that the runtime to determine the minimum element in a set of n numbers is Q(n).
